name: Reed Lewandowski-Hossain
role: Prototype theft and corporate tech acquisition — tech retriever
location: Steamvent Alley — geothermal district, hot and chemical-smelling, near Milwaukee and North Ave
description:
Reed Lewandowski-Hossain is compact and densely muscled, built low to the ground like something designed to survive impacts. At 25, his face is memorable in a profession that rewards forgettability, and he has learned to compensate. The chrome is visible — wired reflexes with adrenaline pump — chemical-mechanical hybrid augmentation — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He inherited the role from a mentor who disappeared on a job four years ago — the mentor's gear, contacts, and unfinished business all came with it. He works as a tech retriever out of Steamvent Alley, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Reed Lewandowski-Hossain has survived long enough in the runner game to be either very good or very lucky, and he cultivates ambiguity on the topic.

core_fears: Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
Their past catching up — debts, enemies, broken promises
core_desires: To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
Knowledge — to understand the systems that grind people down
coping_mechanisms: Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
blind_spots: Thinks speed can substitute for planning because it's worked so far
Refuses to update their mental model of people — first impressions calcify into permanent judgments
Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
psychology.secret: Suki Ekberg-Asare betrayed their previous crew to survive a corporate raid. The crew didn't survive. Nobody in GLMZ knows this.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Flat affect, monotone delivery. The content is terrifying but the voice never rises.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic, almost musical — the sentence structure has a pattern even when the words are brutal.
verbal_tics: Calls everyone 'friend' — the warmth varies from genuine to threatening
Never uses contractions when lying — 'I did not' instead of 'I didn't'
example_lines: "Corporate R&D security is built to stop amateurs. I'm a professional."
"The prototype is worth more than both our lives combined. Handle it carefully."
"I steal things that haven't been invented yet. The future is always in transit."

story_hooks: A dead drop Suki Ekberg-Asare maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
A Tier 4 executive offers Suki Ekberg-Asare a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
Suki Ekberg-Asare is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
narrative_function: As a tech retriever, Suki Ekberg-Asare embodies the tension between independence and isolation. He is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Wired reflexes with adrenaline pump — chemical-mechanical hybrid augmentation. Cybernetic arm — right, full replacement from shoulder — stronger than organic, obvious chrome
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.
affiliation: Freelance — works the Gray Zone circuit exclusively

strengths: photographic memory for faces and layouts
social chameleon — adapts to any environment
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions
old injury that flares under specific conditions

decision_rules: Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
Taps a specific rhythm on hard surfaces when thinking — Morse code for a word they won't say
breaking_points: Being publicly exposed — name, face, address, all of it blown
Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap

physical_description.heritage: Striking blend of Eastern European (40.4%), South Asian (37.4%), Northern European (18.1%), and Sub-Saharan African (4.1%) ancestry. Eastern European bone structure and base complexion provide foundational features, while substantial South Asian ancestry contributes warm undertones, eye depth, and facial proportions. Northern European elements create cool counterpoints and lighter overall tone. Trace Sub-Saharan African heritage adds subtle warmth and richness to skin undertones. The result is a sophisticated, balanced phenotype — warm medium brown with complex golden-olive undertones and cooler notes, neither pale nor deeply saturated.
physical_description.build: Compact and densely muscled, low center of gravity — built for impact absorption and explosive movement rather than reach. Shoulders broad relative to frame, legs thick and powerful.
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium warm brown with golden-olive and cool undertones — the natural result of Eastern European and Northern European base with significant South Asian warmth and trace Sub-Saharan African depth. Complexion ranges from light tan to warm bronze depending on light, carrying both golden and subtle cooler notes. Skin shows refined clarity typical of Eastern European heritage enhanced by South Asian depth.
physical_description.complexion: Strong, defined facial structure with prominent cheekbones and straight nose bridge showing Eastern European influence, balanced by South Asian eye depth and warm undertones. Facial contours carry subtle warmth from mixed ancestry. Skin shows weathering from chemical exposure in Steamvent Alley — slight discoloration around left temple and jawline from ambient pollution. Clean-shaven, minimal grooming beyond necessity.
distinguishing_marks: Faint chemical burn scars along left side of neck and upper chest — pale against warm brown skin, barely raised, from industrial accident or extraction gone wrong
Surgical scar tissue where right arm connects at shoulder — visible chrome interface point, slightly raised and darker than surrounding skin
Small tattoo on inner left wrist — minimalist circuit pattern, functional marker rather than artistic statement
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right arm is full cybernetic replacement from shoulder — brushed steel and gunmetal chrome with visible articulation joints. Wired reflexes manifested as fine servo-assist lines visible under skin at temples, neck, and along spine when moving quickly. Adrenaline pump port visible as sealed chrome nub on right collarbone, faint hydraulic scarring around it.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision — no wasted motion. Stands in slight forward lean, weight distributed low. Right arm hangs with subtle mechanical fluidity that marks him as augmented to anyone paying attention. Eyes track constantly, environmental awareness default state. When relaxed, tension never fully leaves his frame.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian — function over aesthetic. Reinforced synthweave jacket with chemical-resistant coating, worn gray. Cargo pants with deep pockets and cable management loops. Steel-toed work boots, scuffed and well-maintained. Under-layer is reactive mesh undershirt, barely visible at collar. No corporate logos, no team colors. Everything modular and replaceable. Weathered from Steamvent humidity and chemical exposure.
